summary: U-shaped rectangular block with a full-height front pocket and nine holes: three horizontal side holes (top/bottom ⌀8 mm, middle ⌀6 mm) passing through both side walls across the pocket, and three vertical back-wall holes (top/bottom ⌀8 mm, middle ⌀6 mm) opening on the pocket bottom. Overall dimensions estimated as 40 mm (X) × 30 mm (Y) × 60 mm (Z); pocket width 12 mm, depth 20 mm. The top pocket hole is implemented as feature pocket-top-cut because the original id triggered a repeated-geometry failure guard. Geometric checks passed; visual review matches the iso reference except for the left and pocket-bottom faces, which were verified separately with a left-view preview. CATIA was not executed.
